description: This Java class defines an immutable data object representing an interest rate chart, including its properties, constructors, factory methods, and related data collections.

classes.name: InterestRateChartData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a InterestRateChart.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create an InterestRateChartData instance with minimal parameters.

methods.name: withSlabs
methods.description: Creates a new InterestRateChartData instance with specified slabs added.

methods.name: withTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new InterestRateChartData instance with a complete template including options.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a basic InterestRateChartData template with default null values.

methods.name: addChartSlab
methods.description: Adds a chart slab to the collection of chartSlabs.

methods.name: isFromDateAfter
methods.description: Checks if the fromDate is after the provided compareDate.

methods.name: endDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the interest rate chart.

methods.name: fromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the interest rate chart.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the interest rate chart.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns the description of the interest rate chart.

methods.name: chartSlabs
methods.description: Returns the collection of chart slabs.

methods.name: periodTypes
methods.description: Returns the collection of period types options.

methods.name: entityTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns the collection of entity type options.

methods.name: attributeNameOptions
methods.description: Returns the collection of attribute name options.

methods.name: conditionTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns the collection of condition type options.

methods.name: incentiveTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns the collection of incentive type options.

methods.name: genderOptions
methods.description: Returns the collection of gender options.

methods.name: clientTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns the collection of client type options.

methods.name: clientClassificationOptions
methods.description: Returns the collection of client classification options.

methods.name: isPrimaryGroupingByAmount
methods.description: Indicates whether the chart is primary grouped by amount.
